scenes.setting: Coffee by the fireplace: Stuart splits the Whites' fifty-pound bounty (thirty to Sherlock, plus one pound 'transportation'), talk of Desi Bay holidays stirs the promise made with Benson and Melissa — and the parting verdict of a first fan: 'Your talent deserves better coffee.'
A leisurely rest of the day: ox bones and radish for evening soup, more Book of Secrets study — until the doorbell rings like a dinner bugle
scenes.text_anchor: the tantalizing fragrance of the beef bone soup

scenes.setting: Emlyn at the door in Harvest Church robes ('That old man, that old man…'), demanding to see the patient before his good dinner; on the walk over: a medical certificate obtained 'too simply' and why a vampire loves Backlund's sunless gloom
scenes.text_anchor: “Dammit, how do I get rid of this inducing suggestion?”

scenes.setting: The Jurgen house: 'Dr.' Emlyn White examines Mrs. Doris while Brody glares — the disease is irreversible, three to five years at best — but the free medicine lightens her breathing on the spot, and even stoic Jurgen almost smiles
